prompt: Give TemperatureLog custom private writeObject and readObject methods so its transient readings array is written by hand and the transient average is recomputed when the object is read back.
explanation: A private writeObject(ObjectOutputStream) / readObject(ObjectInputStream) pair lets a class take over its own serialization; the JVM finds them by signature, not through an interface. Calling defaultWriteObject and defaultReadObject first handles the non-transient fields, after which you are free to write extra values -- as long as the two methods read and write the same things in the same order. Recomputing a derived field such as average inside readObject is cheaper than storing it and keeps it consistent with the data it came from.
hints: Both methods must be private and have exactly these signatures, otherwise the JVM will not call them.
Write the length first so readObject knows how many readInt calls to make.
After rebuilding the array in readObject, assign it to this.readings and set this.average with the provided mean helper.
